coordinate_system: Top-left origin; integer pixels. Bounding boxes include shadow alpha. Ascending z_order draws back to front.
limitations: Flattened JPEG does not contain recoverable original layers or hidden detail.
Visible source detail is retained through manually traced and color-guided masks. Some boundaries can contain source-background fringes.
Covered regions use reconstructed paper materials; concealed structure is approximate. Doors use visible strip continuation.
Soft shadows are approximated as attached alpha; baked shading cannot be perfectly disentangled from a single JPEG.
Rings are solid concealed discs, with exposed rims forming the visible rings.
This pack is a reconstruction for animation prototyping and needs visual edge cleanup for final production.

verification.status: Approximate reconstruction; not original layered artwork. Manual contour traces and color-guided branch extraction require edge review before production.
